hero.title: Your own corner of Lake Como
hero.description: Crooked House is a charming one-bedroom apartment above Menaggio, with a private entrance, a garden framed by mountains, and a kitchen that is entirely yours.
about.headline: A characterful village home for slow, sunlit days
about.p1: Set in the quiet village of Grandola ed Uniti, just above Menaggio on Lake Como, Crooked House is a lovingly restored one-bedroom apartment. White plaster walls, exposed wooden beams, and cool tiled floors keep the atmosphere calm and airy even on the warmest afternoons.
about.p2: You’ll have the whole apartment to yourself  a private entrance, a comfortable living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a garden framed by the mountains.
gallery.headline: Every corner, thoughtfully considered
gallery.body: From the cosy bedroom to the mountain-framed garden, take a look around before you arrive.
amenities.headline: Everything you need to unwind
amenities.kitchenDesc: Oven, dishwasher, microwave, and coffee machine  cook like a local.
amenities.gardenDesc: A quiet garden with outdoor seating to relax in the sun.
amenities.viewsDesc: Wake up to the forested peaks rising above the village.
amenities.wifiDesc: Fast, reliable Wi‑Fi throughout the apartment, at no extra cost.
amenities.tvDesc: A flat-screen TV with your favourite streaming services ready to go.
amenities.welcomeDesc: Fresh local treats and coffee waiting for you on arrival.
amenities.petDesc: Travelling with a furry companion? They are warmly welcome here.
amenities.parkingDesc: Private parking right by the apartment with easy access to town.
stay.headline: The whole place is yours
stay.body1: Crooked House is a self-contained one-bedroom apartment with its own private entrance. Inside, you’ll find a comfortable double bedroom, a bright living room with a sofa and smart TV, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a fully equipped kitchen.
stay.body2: Step outside into a private garden with outdoor seating and mountain views  and a welcome basket of local treats waiting for you on arrival. Pets are welcome, and parking is free.
reviews.headline: Rated exceptional by every guest
